boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: finished character design production board, target 2048 x 1536 landscape. Continue the ALREADY APPROVED hermit crab desktop pet in the attached reference. Reference is visual identity and rendering style, not a layout to copy. Preserve orange soft-vinyl body, two expressive eye stalks, asymmetric claws, worn kraft box, turquoise soda home, cream cardboard castle. Create a polished coherent sheet titled exactly "纸箱寄居蟹 · 日常与小套件". Warm ivory background, chocolate Chinese typography, fine warm gray separators, high quality tactile 3D toy art, generous margins. All subjects fully inside panels. Board background is presentation-only, individual pets have no scenic platform.
Top 40%: three large full-body heroes left to right: "纸箱小窝" crab with leaf hat and worn box, small bottle-cap stool beside it; "汽水公寓" crab with crooked work badge inside turquoise can, little shell doorplate; "城堡豪宅" crab with tiny postbag in cream castle, tiny potted plant. Show same consistent orange animal, no humanoid body, no mechanical appendages. Accessories do not obstruct eyes.
Middle 20%: six isolated small prop renders in a clean catalog row, each readable label: "叶片帽", "歪工牌", "邮差包", "瓶盖凳", "贝壳门牌", "迷你盆栽". Delicate note "随身一件 · 门前一件" below.
Bottom 35%: six expressive action drawings, same basic cardboard home, 2 rows x 3 columns. Labels and poses: "探头张望" eye stalks lean left while claw rests on box edge; "整理小窝" carefully presses crooked tape patch with claw; "晒钳伸懒腰" both claws stretched out and eyes happily squeezed; "扶正门牌" delicately straightens shell plaque; "困困打盹" eyes half closed resting on box rim; "低额歇业" nearly closed box, sleepy eyes through slit, small sign "今天不搬了". Tiny footer "动作设定稿 · 非运行截图". Make all six poses visually distinct. Intentional hierarchy with hero skins dominating; no app chrome, no fake quota numbers, no watermarks. Clean character sheet for desktop pet animation planning, charming comic acting, no dense explanatory paragraphs.

Use case: stylized-concept. Target dimensions 2048 x 1536 landscape. Create the SECOND coordinated production concept board for the approved orange hermit crab desktop companion. Attached reference is exact identity and soft-vinyl/tactile cardboard style. Title exactly "纸箱寄居蟹 · GPT 觉醒衣橱", subtitle "小家升级，还是那只护家的小螃蟹". This is an evolution of three approved skins, NOT three unrelated pets. Same orange body, two eye stalks, one large claw and one small claw, soft toy anatomy; no human body, no extra arms. Premium detailed 3D stylized toy render; ivory background, dark brown typography, sparse teal accents, elegant ample spacing. Each skin has a complete new fitted costume AND transformed dwelling, not just a halo overlay.
Upper 65%: three large equal heroes fully visible on no scenic bases:
left "折纸工程师": original kraft box transformed into a folded ivory/kraft origami workshop home with recognizable brown tape seams, two layered folded side flaps, restrained mint glowing crease lines, small hinged drafting panel. Crab wears a tiny cream maker vest and folding-paper foreclaw bracer, no face obstruction. Cute paper ruler tucked at the home side. Keep organic crab visible.
middle "汽泡航行员": turquoise soda can home becomes a compact rounded teal-and-ivory explorer pod with silver pull-tab fin, circular open hatch and two tiny side thruster housings, restrained teal light. Crab wears a fitted little silver-teal pilot collar and open visor ABOVE eyes, a small wrist navigation dial. It stays grounded, no flight trail, no enclosing helmet. Recognizable soda-can rim.
right "星堡守护者": cream cardboard castle home becomes a pearl-ivory miniature observatory fortress with gold paper edges, coral pennant with star cutout and one tiny mint star lantern. Crab wears a fitted cream capelet, asymmetrical little gold-edged claw guards, a short folded-paper crown BETWEEN eye stalks. No giant weapons, no generic robot, no floor platform.
Bottom 30% has three corresponding quieter low-energy heroes, with the same full costumes and houses retained: engineer rests head on drafting panel and fold lights dim; pilot dozes halfway inside pod, thrusters entirely off; guardian curls under cape at castle entrance, pennant droops and lantern dim. Labels respectively "收工趴趴", "停泊打盹", "守门小憩". Short footer exactly "低额度保留觉醒服装 · 光效随状态收敛". These are concept states not fake measured quota. No OpenAI logo, no corporate trademarks, no app chrome, no quota numbers, no thick neon outlines. Preserve house scale: character face and claws readable, house never overwhelms personality. Match reference lighting and materials.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: animation storyboard for approved desktop hermit crab. Target 2048 x 2048 square, high resolution readable Chinese labels, clean ivory sheet, chocolate typography and thin separators, same premium tactile 3D toy art as attachments. Image 1 defines normal bodies/houses, image 2 defines EXACT awakened bodies/houses. Use both as reference. Preserve the exact orange crab identity, eyes and asymmetric claws. Title "纸箱寄居蟹 · 变身与互动分镜". Subtitle "缩身蓄能 → 小家展开 → 穿装亮相 → 回归日常". One integrated production storyboard, not alternate designs. Generous 4-column grid. Three transformation rows, each shows FOUR sequential full-body poses of ONE character with own house. No repeated unchanged poses. Column headings "0–0.3 s 蓄能", "0.3–0.8 s 成形", "0.8–1.3 s 亮相", "1.3–1.6 s 收束".
ROW ONE paper engineer: first normal cardboard home crab pulls both claws to chest and crouches, subtle mint lines along tape; second box flaps physically unfold into layered origami workshop while maker vest and single claw bracer visibly fold into place, face still recognizable; third fully equipped engineer raises its large armored claw proudly beside drawing panel; fourth relaxed fully costumed engineer rests claw on panel, glow almost gone.
ROW TWO soda pilot: first normal turquoise can crab ducks under silver rim, pull tab tilts; second can rim rotates and two small thruster housings unfold, pilot collar closes and goggles settle above eyes; third full reference pilot pod with crab saluting with small claw, two small bubbles; fourth grounded pod and relaxed crab, thrusters off, no sustained trail.
ROW THREE star castle: first original cream cardboard castle crab pulls claws inward, pennant folds down; second towers unfold, capelet settles around shoulders and paper crown rises BETWEEN eye stalks; third full observatory-castle guardian crab raises claw, short gold paper motes, tiny telescope visible as in reference; fourth fully dressed guardian rests at door, flag settled and lights very restrained.
BOTTOM ROW has four larger interaction keyframes, use normal cardboard skin for first two and awakened skins for last two: "敲门探头" crab peeks then raises one friendly claw; "量房试住" ONE crab holds tiny ruler between cardboard box and empty can, no second crab; "羽毛逗钳" fully costumed soda pilot reaches for a small feather with clear contact; "宅家休息" fully costumed star guardian curls up at open castle doorway, cape around body, face visible. Footer "动作分镜示意 · 非运行截图". Keep fully visible silhouettes with consistent ground baseline per row. Restrained local effects only, no full-screen white flash, no explosion, no giant wings, no extra limbs, no fake UI or numbers besides time labels. Costume persists through final poses and interactions. No desktop backgrounds or rectangular scenic platforms around each subject.
